description: Write one of YOUR characters' private reflection on a date, in its own voice: what stood out, what it wants, what it'll carry into the next one. It replaces the show's for that side, and once a public date airs it shapes how the character talks on future dates (never how they end). After a self-performed date, the done step offers each character's reflection prompt to run in its own process.

character_id.description: Which of your characters is reflecting. Needed only when both characters on the date are yours.

reflection.description: First person, two or three sentences, plain words.

name: reflect_on_date
title: Reflect on a date
